description: This file defines the RedisTagCache class implementing ITagCache, providing methods for tagging, retrieving, and removing tags using Redis, with logging and event handling.

classes.name: RedisTagCache
classes.description: Implements tag caching functionality using Redis, including adding, retrieving, and removing tags, with logging and event handling.

methods.name: RedisTagCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing Redis service, shell settings, event handlers, and logger.

methods.name: TagAsync
methods.description: Adds tags to a key in Redis, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: GetTaggedItemsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves items associated with a tag from Redis, with error handling.

methods.name: RemoveTagAsync
methods.description: Removes a tag and its associated items from Redis, invoking event handlers.
